properties.NAME: BANNOCK
properties.CHANGE: BANNOCK lost to creation of CARIBOU. Same act also authorized BANNOCK to annex territory from CARIBOU, dependent on a vote in the general election of November 1920. Proposed annexation failed in referendum [see Unsuccessful Proposals - Annex 1].
properties.CITATION: (Id. Laws 1919, 15th sess., ch. 5/pp. 28-42;Id. Code Ann. (1996), vol. 6, ch. 1, sec. 31-117 "Caribou Co."/p. 24)
